images.title: A ribbon of 9 m with 3 m 40 cm cut off
images.purpose: Show subtracting a length: a ribbon of 9 m, the cut piece of 3 m 40 cm and the piece left, 5 m 60 cm.
images.composition: One tape in cm below, one long ribbon bar above split into a cut part and a left part.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. RIBBON: one long bar 1170 px wide and 90 px high (x 143 to 1313, y 250 to 340), 1 cm is 1.3 px, split by one vertical line at x 585 into an amber #E69F00 part 442 px wide (x 143 to 585) labelled inside cut off 3 m 40 cm in dark 40 px, and a teal #0072B2 part 728 px wide (x 585 to 1313) labelled inside left 5 m 60 cm in white 44 px. WHOLE: one grey #6B7280 bracket above the ribbon from x 143 to x 1313 at y 200 with short end strokes and the label 9 m = 900 cm above it in 48 px bold at x 728, y 150. TAPE: one horizontal line from x 143 to x 1313 at y 480 with exactly 10 tall tick marks (40 px) at every 130 px (x 143, 273, 403, 533, 663, 793, 923, 1053, 1183 and 1313) labelled below in 36 px 0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800 and 900, and the unit cm at x 1380, y 480. RESULT: across the bottom centre, y 680, one line of bold text 900 − 340 = 560 cm = 5 m 60 cm in 56 px. In all: 1 ribbon, 2 parts, 1 tape, 10 ticks. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a cut part or a left part of a different length
images.takeaway: Change to cm, subtract, and change back: 9 m − 3 m 40 cm = 5 m 60 cm.
images.description: A ribbon of 9 m with a cut piece of 3 m 40 cm and the piece left, 5 m 60 cm, on a tape in cm.
images.context: Concept image for Subtracting Lengths. It follows the idea of the electricians' cable in your maths book (a length used from a longer length) and shows the concept's own example, a ribbon of 9 m with 3 m 40 cm cut off (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Show the two parts and the whole on the tape. The slip to watch: taking 40 cm from 0 cm as 0 cm.
